dialogues.speaker: Alvard
dialogues.text: We really haven't got anything worth looking at right now!

dialogues.speaker: Alvard
dialogues.text: Last time you and Little Skylark bought all my stock. Then I had problems restocking. All my regulars were complaining they couldn't even get a bottle of Fonta. The reputational damage...

dialogues.speaker: Alvard
dialogues.text: Anyway, there's nothing here worth your time. I suggest you try elsewhere.
